briefing: An unusual pattern of IAM activities has been detected in your environment. You need to quickly assess whether there is a potential threat involving unauthorized access or data breaches.
known_context: A suspicious IAM user has logged in multiple times from a single IP address.
CloudTrail logs show several failed login attempts from the same IP.
There is a history of IAM user creating new access keys without proper authorization.
coach_guidance: Start by investigating the suspicious IAM user and their recent activities. Look for signs of unauthorized access or data exfiltration.
